data.name: Beyond The Gate
data.detailed_description:
Beyond The Gate is a medieval extraction adventure inspired by Welsh folklore, history and landscape.

Leave the safety of Caerwyn Castle to hunt, explore and gather valuable supplies from the dangerous world beyond its walls. Every journey is a gamble: the further you travel, the greater the potential reward — but you must make it back before the gates close at nightfall.

Fail to return, and everything you carried beyond the walls may be lost.

Return Before Nightfall

The gates will not remain open forever. Keep an eye on the fading daylight, decide when you've pushed your luck far enough, and begin the journey home before it's too late.

Explore Beyond the Gates

Travel through forests, ruins, graveyards, abandoned settlements and other forgotten places. Hunt wildlife, gather resources, search for valuable equipment and uncover stories hidden throughout the world.

Fight to Survive

Face bandits, dangerous wildlife and powerful enemies using melee weapons and bows. Choose your fights carefully — sometimes returning alive with what you've found is more valuable than winning another battle.

A World Inspired by Wales

Discover locations and stories influenced by Welsh folklore, history and landscape, from ancient legends to forgotten figures and places inspired by Wales' past.

Return to Caerwyn

Successfully return with your spoils to store valuable equipment, trade, craft, cook, complete quests and prepare for your next journey beyond the gates.

Key Features:

  • Extraction-based survival gameplay: venture beyond the walls, gather what you can, and return before time runs out

  • Quests and forgotten stories: take on jobs from those within the castle and uncover stories hidden throughout the world.

  • Journey Beyond the Gates: every journey is shaped by the pressure to make it back before the gates close

  • Risk-driven exploration: decide how far to push into dangerous territory and what is worth bringing home

  • Melee and ranged combat: fight with weapons and bows against enemies and creatures in the wild

  • Hunting and resource gathering: collect materials, hunt for food, and scavenge valuable supplies

  • Castle-based progression: use what you bring back to craft equipment, cook meals, and prepare for future runs

  • A world inspired by Welsh folklore: explore a dark setting influenced by Welsh myth, atmosphere, and landscape

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
